notes.title: Beta Update v2.0.2
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

I have been working hard over the past few months to bring an overhauled version of this excavator simulator to everyone. See release notes below for all that has changed in this beta version.

This beta version is a preview of what has been in development and feedback is greatly encouraged.

Note that this is a beta and everything is subject to change and improvement.

To access beta branch:
[olist]
Right click game title in library and select properties
Select the Betas tab and select beta
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40092242/3ade7270fc4ce926ebf34b3d3fd4b0a53edacde5.png


Thank you everyone for the support,
Happy Year!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40092242/c68433e933d29f7bf703bdbc290e21595de65f6f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40092242/69fcccfa3afeb67a9eb1581462b44cb7cb72aae4.png

RELEASE NOTES
New Features

Add sandbox mode
Add virtual tablet in cab for non-obstructive notifications and instructions
Overhauled menu system with more options
Add anti-dig zones

Bug Fixes

 Fixes player flipping around if excavator arm forced into dirt
 Fixes VR controller input bugs
 Fixes flying excavator movement bug

Game Engine

Migrated from STEAMVR API in favor of OpenXR* API to allow greater marketplace compatibility
 Update Unity version to 2021.2.7

Performance Improvements

 Decrease terrain loading times by up to 500%
 Allow for more complex terrain designs
 More dirt particles on screen
 Increase supported map size to 256x256 meters and 256 meters in height
 Optimize terrain chunk rendering
 Removed grass in favor of performance
 Reduced 3d excavator treads in favor of scroll texture for performance gains

Accuracy Improvements

 Virtual joystick calculations to use rotational instead of positional data
 Realistic physics-based hydraulics simulation (No clipping through ground)
 Excavator movement is more accurate to that of a tracked machine
 Realistic excavator movement where power is decreased on slopes

Terrain Digging

 No more bucket clipping through ground
 Precise bucket control of dig areas
 Use back of bucket teeth for fine dirt manipulation
 6 terrain materials (grass, dry grass, rock, dirt, gravel, mud)

Dirt Particles

 Replace dirt cubes for rock-like objects with respective materials
 Popcorn like dirt absorb is less likely to occur
 Add support for 6 types of terrain material particles
 Dirt volume preserved more than previously
 Dirt particles move with the bucket more consistently


KNOWN ISSUES

Multiple tablets can be spawned in to scene
Piston floats away from excavator after a few minutes
On some VR devices the forward direction cannot be changed


	
*Both Oculus App and SteamVR Launcher support OpenXR API. If the game does not detect your headset, make sure your Oculus App or SteamVR is up to date and for SteamVR users, that the OpenXR Runtime is set to SteamVR (SteamVR -> Settings -> Developer -> Set OpenXR Runtime). Oculus App usually defaults as OpenXR Runtime. Please checkout the discord if you run into any issues.

notes.title: Great First Month
notes.content:
First month!
Excavator Simulator VR has had a great first month! As a solo developer just finishing university, it has been an exciting first release. The goal is to take this "school project" and turn it into the excavator simulator we all want it to be.

Sales and community support has surpassed expectations. This allows for reinvestment in the simulator, continuation of development, and additional future feature updates. A general development roadmap is shown below.

Community

Community feedback is very important to me. I want the community to have a say in the development process. The more a certain feature is suggested, the more likely it will be implemented or fast tracked in releases.

We now have a discord!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40092242/9129942a78afb891bd75b94307825444d6c9cd0c.png
Leave suggestions in the Improvements or New Features discussion.

The future
Let's talk about what the future looks like**. This is a general roadmap*:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40092242/9f1a542bbc73c604d4e12894d5f5a546777bea01.png
Note that features may be added or removed from these updates and updates may be pushed to a beta branch for early testing of features before an official release.

The overall plan is to build out the core systems of the simulator in order to better support growth in the future.

Stability Update (Fall 2021):

 Sandbox mode
 Terrain optimizations (Support for larger truly open world maps and more terrain types)
 Improve excavator movement (More closely mimic real-world track movement)
 Improve hydraulic joints (Max joint force similar to real-world hydraulic joints)
 Reduce digging glitches
 Scenario support (Allows for more levels/missions to be added in the future. This does not include Steam workshop support though)

Quality of Life Update (End of 2021/beginning 2022):

 Add basic sounds (Menu, excavator, dirt, ambiance...)
 Complete UI overhaul (New assets and menus)
 VR controller joystick support (Use VR controller joystick instead of virtual joysticks)
 Xbox controller support (Excavation without the use of VR controllers)
 Recording camera (Display exactly what user sees in VR for recording purposes. This also includes new camera angles for steamers)

Feature Update (TBD)

 This will be the exciting update with all the good new features and content. (Most excited about this one.)


*This game is developed by a solo developer working on the project as a hobby so development will take some time and all dates are only estimates.

**Even though this game has been released as a full game, development will still continue as if it were in early access.
